title: Order receipt
brief:
An order receipt from the Orbit Shop.

- Preview text: "Order #10482 is confirmed."
- Heading: "Thanks for your order"
- Text: "Order #10482"
- A table of line items, item on the left and price on the right:
  - "Linen shirt × 1" — "$68.00"
  - "Canvas tote × 2" — "$48.00"
  - "Wool socks × 3" — "$36.00"
- Then "Subtotal" "$152.00", "Shipping" "$8.00", and a bold "Total" "$160.00".
- Two address columns, side by side on desktop and stacked on phones:
  - "Ship to": "Sam Rivera, 18 Valencia St, San Francisco, CA 94103"
  - "Billing": "Sam Rivera, PO Box 221, Oakland, CA 94604"
- Button "Track your order" linking to https://shop.orbit.dev/orders/10482, background #111111, white text.
- Footer: "Questions? Reply to this email."
- White background, 600px content.
